sections.Base stat block: Wraith, SRD 5.1. Add the sorcerer spellcasting below and use CR 6.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. The wraith moves through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends a turn inside an object.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
sections.Actions:
Life Drain. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 21 (4d8 + 3) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 14 Constitution save, reduce the target's maximum HP by the necrotic damage taken until it finishes a long rest. The target dies if the reduction brings its maximum to 0.
Create Specter. A humanoid within 10 ft. who died violently in the last minute rises as a Specter in its corpse's space or the nearest free space. The wraith controls up to seven specters at once.
sections.Spellcasting:
8th-level sorcerer spellcaster. Charisma, save DC 13, spell attack +5.
At will: Mage Hand, Magic Missile, Minor Illusion.
3/day: Lightning Bolt.
1/day: Hypnotic Pattern.

statBlock.description: A dead spellcaster whose spirit retains its arcane talents.

statBlock.name: Crater Wurm
statBlock.otherStatistics: Saving Throws Con +11, Wis +4 Senses blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 9 Languages —

sections.Base stat block: Purple Worm, SRD 5.1. Remove Multiattack and Tail Stinger. Keep Bite and add Breach and Contaminated Gullet.
sections.Traits:
Tunneler. Burrow through solid rock at half burrow speed, leaving a 10-ft.-diameter tunnel.
Contaminated Gullet. Each time a swallowed creature takes acid damage inside the wurm, it also gains one contamination level.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. A Large or smaller target must pass a DC 19 Dexterity save or be swallowed. A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover against effects outside the wurm, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the wurm in one turn, the wurm makes a DC 21 Constitution save at that turn's end. On a failure it expels all swallowed creatures, which land Prone within 10 ft. A creature inside a dead wurm is no longer Restrained and can spend 20 ft. of movement to leave the corpse and land Prone.
Breach. The wurm uses its full movement and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Whenever it enters a creature's space, that creature makes a DC 19 Strength save. On success, the creature can choose to be moved to the side of the wurm's space. On failure, or if it succeeds and declines that movement, it takes 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage, is pushed 10 ft., and falls Prone. After finishing this movement, the wurm can make one Bite attack against a Prone target as a bonus action.

statBlock.description: A purple worm mutated by delerium deep in the crater.

sections.Base stat block: Stone Giant, SRD 5.1. Replace Stone Camouflage with Regeneration, Contaminating Beam and Misty Camouflage. Use CR 8.
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. In the Deep Haze, regain 10 HP at the start of each turn. The gargant dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and does not regenerate.
Misty Camouflage. The gargant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 17 Strength save or fall Prone.
Contaminating Beam. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and gains one contamination level.
sections.Reactions: Rock Catching. When a rock or similar missile is hurled at the gargant, it can catch the missile with a successful DC 10 Dexterity save to prevent the bludgeoning damage.

sections.Sacrament of the Falling Fire: A one-hour rite in the Deep Haze, range 30 ft. Up to twelve willing, faithful Humanoids each use a 100 gp delerium fragment and become sanctified. Each confronts a hostile Shadow or, if the GM judges that the participant harbors substantial anger, fear or hatred, a Wraith. While faithful, they have advantage on saves against Charmed or Frightened, resist necrotic and radiant damage, and are immune to contamination. If they die, their soul enters the fragment and cannot be raised while it remains there.
sections.Encounter notes: Gresha performs the Sacrament at dusk. If destroyed, Lucretia Mathias calls back her spirit as soon as she can.

name: Tower Dragon
pages: Appendix A, p. 198. Castle guardians, Chapter 9, p. 181.
notes: Young Bronze Dragon, SRD 5.1. Add the listed guardian traits and defenses and use CR 10. Keep the dragon’s two breath options and lightning immunity.

statBlock.name: Tower Dragon
statBlock.otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +3, Con +7, Wis +4, Cha +6. Insight +4, Perception +7, Stealth +3. Resists poison and psychic, plus bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons that are not adamantine. Immune to lightning. Condition immunities Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Poisoned. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 17. Common, Draconic.

sections.Base stat block: Young Bronze Dragon, SRD 5.1. Add the listed guardian traits and defenses and use CR 10. Keep the dragon’s two breath options and lightning immunity.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathe air and water.
Constructed Nature. Requires no air, food, drink or sleep.
False Appearance. While motionless it looks like an ordinary bronze statue.
Faultless Tracker. Creatures that caused the dragon to animate become its quarry. It knows their direction and distance while they remain in Drakkenheim or until it is destroyed.
Immutable Form. Immune to spells and effects that change its form.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Rejuvenation. After destruction, it regains all HP in 1 hour unless Disintegrate is cast on its remains.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Breath Weapons (recharge 5–6). Choose one breath. Lightning Breath is a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide. Each creature in it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save against 55 (10d10) lightning damage, halved on success. Repulsion Breath is a 30-ft. cone. On a failed DC 15 Strength save, a creature in it is pushed 40 ft. away from the dragon.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, p. 198. Castle guardians, Chapter 9, p. 181.
